title: Sal Gives Advice

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: There you are. Listen, I'm doing my best with this place but it's like trying to milk rats.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There you are. Listen, I'm doing my best with this place but it's like trying to milk rats.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: The problem is that your food tastes like food.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The problem is that your food tastes like food.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Where d'ya think budget cheese comes from?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Where d'ya think budget cheese comes from?

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: It should taste like PASSION. And LUST. And garlic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It should taste like PASSION. And LUST. And garlic.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: There's only one way. With a sauce so secret, so powerful that only a few truly great chefs are entrusted with the recipe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's only one way. With a sauce so secret, so powerful that only a few truly great chefs are entrusted with the recipe.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: What do you take me for? Of course I do!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you take me for? Of course I do!

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: No no! Not so fast. You must EARN the secret of the sauce. There is a test that every chef must past to prove their worth.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No no! Not so fast. You must EARN the secret of the sauce. There is a test that every chef must past to prove their worth.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: You want the secret or not?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You want the secret or not?

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Question one: what is the key to a truly great seafood chowder?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Question one: what is the key to a truly great seafood chowder?

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: You're not taking this seriously! And that blue powder is overrated.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're not taking this seriously! And that blue powder is overrated.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Well, that was an easy one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, that was an easy one.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: What is the correct way to mix a souffle?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is the correct way to mix a souffle?

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Do you think this is some sort of joke?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you think this is some sort of joke?

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: What is the best dressing to accompany a Rat Meat salad?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is the best dressing to accompany a Rat Meat salad?

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Aha! It was a trick question! There is no best dressing! Rat meat salad is for plebs!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aha! It was a trick question! There is no best dressing! Rat meat salad is for plebs!

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Shut up. Question four. Should I keep this moustache, or grow a bread?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Shut up. Question four. Should I keep this moustache, or grow a bread?

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Everything is related. Right, last question. All food should be cooked with...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Everything is related. Right, last question. All food should be cooked with...?

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: I think so too. Right, last question. All food should be cooked with...?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think so too. Right, last question. All food should be cooked with...?

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Perhaps you are worthy of the secret of the sauce...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Perhaps you are worthy of the secret of the sauce...

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Crabsticks, no! The secret of the sauce would be wasted on a tasteless egg like you. Sal's outta here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Crabsticks, no! The secret of the sauce would be wasted on a tasteless egg like you. Sal's outta here.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Swear on my toque you won't tell another living soul?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Swear on my toque you won't tell another living soul?

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Alright. It is a special compound, developed by top Curzona scientists. Apixibalamin-Sumasulin-V. Street: the Tongue-Twister.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright. It is a special compound, developed by top Curzona scientists. Apixibalamin-Sumasulin-V. Street: the Tongue-Twister.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: One grain of TT and customers will be licking holes in the plates.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One grain of TT and customers will be licking holes in the plates.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: So? One grain of TT and customers will be licking holes in the plates.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So? One grain of TT and customers will be licking holes in the plates.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Morals get you nowhere. Every kitchen in Nivalis uses it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Morals get you nowhere. Every kitchen in Nivalis uses it.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: Fine. Be mediocre. Kiss our chance at a Golden Serviette award goodbye. See if Sal cares.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine. Be mediocre. Kiss our chance at a Golden Serviette award goodbye. See if Sal cares.

nodes.speaker: Sal Magundi II
nodes.text: I used to have a man down by the Docks, until the... unfortunate incident with the trout. But I hear a dealer called Luminita might be able to get some.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I used to have a man down by the Docks, until the... unfortunate incident with the trout. But I hear a dealer called Luminita might be able to get some.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right. So how do we do that?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. So how do we do that?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Right. So how do we do that?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Right. So how do we do that?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But I'm not ready for a quiz

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I'm not ready for a quiz
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But I'm not ready for a quiz
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But I'm not ready for a quiz

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That blue powder they sell behind Bigger Burger?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That blue powder they sell behind Bigger Burger?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That blue powder they sell behind Bigger Burger?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That blue powder they sell behind Bigger Burger?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How is this related to cheffing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How is this related to cheffing?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How is this related to cheffing?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How is this related to cheffing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So, where do we get some?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, where do we get some?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So, where do we get some?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So, where do we get some?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Great chefs like you know how to make the sauce?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Great chefs like you know how to make the sauce?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Great chefs like you know how to make the sauce?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Great chefs like you know how to make the sauce?
